lines.en: label firsttimestreets:
scene citystreets
Not really knowing what else to do with this sudden abundance of free time, I decide to get a little more acquainted with the city.
lines.zh: 不太清楚该怎么打发这突如其来的大把空闲时间，我决定再熟悉熟悉这座城市。

lines.en: I’m still getting used to this place, so I figure that the quicker I can actually figure out where I am, the quicker I can...I don't know. Do stuff?
lines.zh: 我还在适应这个地方，所以我想，越快弄清自己身在何处，就能越快……我也不知道。去做点事？

lines.en: Plus, being out in the open gives me a better chance to run into someone than just sitting around in my room- and I believe that the easiest way to kill time is by distracting yourself with the presence of others.
lines.zh: 再说，出门在外总比窝在房间里更容易遇上什么人——而且我相信，打发时间最简单的办法，就是用别人的存在来分散自己的注意力。

lines.en: Granted, that mindset gets a lot worse considering the only people I have any reason to spend time with right now are teenagers, but it doesn't really matter.
lines.zh: 当然，考虑到眼下我唯一有理由共度时光的人都是些高中生，这种心态听起来就更糟了，不过也无所谓。

lines.en: No one’s judging here. At least not to my knowledge.
lines.zh: 这儿没人评判。至少据我所知没有。

lines.en: And if I'm going to be making the most of my time in this...new world or whatever it is, dwelling on how anyone else feels will just hold me back.
lines.zh: 而如果我要在这个……新世界、或者随便什么鬼地方好好利用我的时间，一味纠结别人的感受只会拖我后腿。

lines.en: If all of this is fake, I have nothing to fear.
lines.zh: 如果这一切都是假的，我就没什么好怕的。

lines.en: scene yumibridge1
If all of this is fake, I am free to live as I please.
lines.zh: 如果这一切都是假的，我就可以随心所欲地生活。

lines.en: I walk up a flight of stairs onto a bridge overlooking the same part of town I have to go through in order to make it to school and take in the sights from a brand new perspective.
lines.zh: 我爬上一段楼梯，来到一座天桥上。桥下正是我上学必经的那片城区，我从一个全新的角度把这景色尽收眼底。

lines.en: The light of the setting sun illuminates the body of a young girl and looks beautiful in the several seconds before she exercises {i}her{/i} free will to spit on a passing car.
lines.zh: 夕阳的光打在一个年轻女孩身上，在她行使{i}自己的{/i}自由意志、往一辆路过的车上吐口水之前的那几秒钟里，美极了。

lines.en: She misses dramatically, but I'm sure she'll have many more chances.
lines.zh: 她吐得离谱地偏，不过我敢说她以后机会多得是。

lines.en: The mysterious girl lets out a sigh and stares off into the distance.
lines.zh: 那个神秘的女孩叹了口气，望向远方。

lines.en: I wonder what it is that brought her here?
lines.zh: 我在想，是什么把她带到这儿来的？

lines.en: I wonder why she isn't with anyone else?
lines.zh: 我在想，她为什么没和别人在一起？

lines.en: Something inside of me convinces me to call out.
lines.zh: 我内心有什么东西说服了我开口。

lines.en: : Hey.
scene yumibridge2
: The fuck do {i}you{/i} want?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}他妈想干嘛？

lines.en: Apparently, that something is entirely unaware that not {i}everyone{/i} here unabashedly celebrates my existence.
lines.zh: 显然，那个「什么东西」完全没意识到，这里并不是{i}每个人{/i}都毫不掩饰地为我的存在而欢呼。

lines.en: : Nothing in particular. Just...looking around, I guess.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的事。只是……四处看看，大概。

lines.en: scene yumibridge3
: Uh-huh. Right.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。是吗。

lines.en: : So you just happened to {i}look around{/i} exactly where I'm hanging out? Couldn't get on with your {i}adventure{/i} before annoying me first?
lines.zh: : 所以您就这么{i}四处看看{/i}，正好看到了我待的地方？不先烦我一下，您那趟{i}冒险{/i}就进行不下去了？

lines.en: : Apparently. But what's even more confusing than that is the abrupt appearance of ska music.
lines.zh: : 显然。不过比这更让人摸不着头脑的，是突然冒出来的斯卡音乐。

lines.en: scene yumibridge4
: Ska...music? The fuck are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 斯卡……音乐？你他妈在说什么？

lines.en: : This one of those fuckin' hidden camera shows or some shit? Cause I ain't cool with being filmed, dickweed.
lines.zh: : 这是那种该死的偷拍节目还是什么鬼？我可不愿意被拍，蠢货。

lines.en: scene yumibridge2
: The hell are you even sayin' hi to me for? What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么跟我打招呼？你想干嘛？

lines.en: : Just thought you could use a little company if you're going to be hanging out up here. And since the two of us aren't doing anything-
lines.zh: : 只是觉得你要在这儿待着，也许需要有人作伴。而且既然我们俩都没事做——

lines.en: : What? You thought you'd just call out to a girl who's like a fifth of your age and that she'd get all excited to hang out with you or some shit?
lines.zh: : 什么？你以为随便朝一个年纪只有你五分之一的女生喊一声，她就会兴奋地想跟你待在一起还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Gimme a break. This ain't some fuckin' manga or whatever.
lines.zh: : 省省吧。这又不是什么该死的漫画之类的。

lines.en: : First off, there is absolutely no way I'm even half as old as you think I am.
lines.zh: : 首先，我绝对不可能有你以为的那么老的一半。

lines.en: : And second, you should try to remember I'm responsible for your grades before you start doing things like insulting me and spitting on random cars.
lines.zh: : 其次，在你开始侮辱我、往陌生车上吐口水之前，你最好记住——你的成绩归我管。

lines.en: I attempt to flex my newfound teacher muscle but, considering the type of girl Yumi appears to be, I doubt it will do anything.
lines.zh: 我试着抖一抖自己新获得的教师威风，不过考虑到 Yumi 看起来是那种女孩，我怀疑这招没什么用。

lines.en: scene yumibridge5
: Oh, suck my dick. You can't control where I spit. We ain't even in school right now. You've got no right to say shit like that to me.
lines.zh: : 哦，去吃我的屌吧。我往哪儿吐口水你管不着。我们现在又不在学校里。你没资格对我说那种话。

lines.en: Yup. Entirely ineffective.
lines.zh: 果然。完全无效。

lines.en: Let's try a new strategy.
lines.zh: 换个新策略吧。

lines.en: : You're just a lot cuter when you're not projectile-salivating on commuters.
lines.zh: : 你要是不对着路人喷射口水，其实可爱多了。

lines.en: scene yumibridge6
: Excuse me?! The fuck did you just say?!
lines.zh: : 你说什么？！你他妈刚才说什么？！

lines.en: : I'll throw you off this bridge right now, fuckface!
lines.zh: : 我现在就把你从这桥上扔下去，傻逼！

lines.en: Strategy two is also a bust and I immediately question why I had to be reborn into a place like this instead of one where I am universally loved.
lines.zh: 第二个策略也失败了，我立刻开始怀疑，为什么我非得转生到这种地方，而不是一个所有人都爱我的世界。

lines.en: : If you want to try and lift me, go ahead. But I'm twice your size and I can't imagine you really want to touch me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你要是想试着把我举起来，尽管来。不过我个头是你的两倍，而且我实在想象不出你一开始就真想碰我。

lines.en: : Well...you're right about the touching part. But I ain't some dainty, little princess! I'm strong as shit!
lines.zh: : 嗯……碰你那部分你说对了。不过我可不是什么娇滴滴的小公主！我他妈壮得很！

lines.en: : I'm sure you are, Yumi. I'm very intimidated.
lines.zh: : 我相信你很壮，Yumi。我怕极了。

lines.en: : I am! I ain't fuckin' around!
lines.zh: : 我是认真的！我没他妈在开玩笑！

lines.en: scene yumibridge7
: Wanna know what happened to the last guy who tried to fuck with me?
lines.zh: : 想知道上一个敢惹我的家伙怎么了吗？

lines.en: : Kicked him so hard in the dick that I heard it fuckin' broke. You tryin' to be next?
lines.zh: : 我照他裆下狠狠一脚，听说那玩意儿他妈的断了。你想当下一个？

lines.en: : I would prefer to keep my penis intact, thank you.
lines.zh: : 我还是希望我的阴茎保持完好，谢谢。

lines.en: scene yumibridge2
: Say the word {i}penis{/i} around me again and I swear to fucking God I'll cut it off.
lines.zh: : 你敢再在我面前说{i}阴茎{/i}这两个字，我对天发誓我把它割下来。

lines.en: : You make even responding to you extremely difficult, you know.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，连回你的话都变得极其困难。

lines.en: if day21 == True:
Does Yumi really have nothing better to do than just...hang out places like this during her free time?
lines.zh: Yumi 在空闲时间真的就没有别的事可做，只能……在这种地方晃荡吗？

lines.en: I mean...I'm doing the same right now. But still.
lines.zh: 我是说……我现在也在做同样的事。不过还是。

lines.en: It was just the other day I found her in some random alley in the middle of the night. Now she's busy loitering here instead.
lines.zh: 就在前几天，我在半夜的一条无名小巷里撞见过她。现在她又改在这儿游荡了。

lines.en: else:
I still obviously don't know Yumi very well, but it's clear that she's not very fond of whoever inhabited this body last.
lines.zh: 显然我还是不太了解 Yumi，但很明显，她不太喜欢上一任住在这具身体里的人。

lines.en: Frankly, it feels like even trying to get to know her at this point is a lost cause.
lines.zh: 说实话，事到如今，连试着去了解她都像是在白费力气。

lines.en: : So, is this just...where you hang out or something?
lines.zh: : 那么，这儿就是……你常待的地方之类的？

lines.en: scene yumibridge8
: If I say yes, are you going to fucking stalk me all the time? Cause I really don't wanna deal with that shit.
lines.zh: : 我要说是，你是不是就要他妈天天跟踪我？我可真不想应付那种破事。

lines.en: : Just...trying to learn more about one of my students.
lines.zh: : 只是……想多了解了解我的一个学生。

lines.en: scene yumibridge4
: Why? I barely even come to class.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我几乎都不来上课。

lines.en: : Hey, you don't have to come {i}at all{/i} if you don't want to. It doesn't make much of a difference to me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你要是不想来，{i}完全{/i}可以不来。对我来说没什么区别。

lines.en: scene yumibridge9
: Wait, what? You serious?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？你认真的？

lines.en: : You ain't gonna, like...lecture me or some shit?
lines.zh: : 你不会……训我一顿之类的？

lines.en: : The fuck is goin' on with you today? This ain't normal.
lines.zh: : 你今天他妈的怎么回事？这不正常。

lines.en: : I guess you could say I've got a new lease on life. Come whenever you want or just...don't. It's up to you.
lines.zh: : 你可以说我是重获新生了。想来就来，或者……就别来。随你。

lines.en: : I just want to know what you're busy doing when you're {i}not{/i} in school.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，你{i}不{/i}在学校的时候都在忙什么。

lines.en: scene yumibridge5
: Well...nothing lately. Pretty much everybody I used to chill with is like, out in space or whatever now.
lines.zh: : 嗯……最近什么都没有。以前跟我混的那帮人，现在差不多都跑到太空去了还是什么的。

lines.en: I assume she's talking about those Yakuza-looking guys my journal mentioned.
lines.zh: 我猜她说的是我那本日志里提到的、看着像黑帮的那几个人。

lines.en: : We’d hang out at the arcade...shoot the shit...pick the locks on Pachinko machines for some free cash...
lines.zh: : 我们以前会泡在游戏厅……瞎扯淡……撬弹珠机的锁换点免费的钱……

lines.en: : You know how it is.
lines.zh: : 你懂的。

lines.en: : Wow, Pachinko machines. I can only imagine how feared you must be around here.
lines.zh: : 哇，弹珠机。光是想想就知道你在这片儿有多让人闻风丧胆。

lines.en: scene yumibridge6
: Yo! Cut it the fuck out! You don't know shit about what I've been through!
lines.zh: : 喂！他妈给我闭嘴！我经历过什么你他妈一无所知！

lines.en: : Can guarantee you the life I lead is a lot rougher than hangin’ out with your friggin’ {i}niece{/i} all day.
lines.zh: : 我敢保证，我过的日子可比你整天跟你那该死的{i}侄女{/i}混在一起艰难多了。

lines.en: scene yumibridge2
: The hell is even up with that? You guys are way too fuckin' close for family.
lines.zh: : 那到底算怎么回事？你们俩对一家人来说也太他妈亲密了吧。

lines.en: : I bet she ain't even your real [niece] and is just some fuckin' mindslave you bought on the market or something.
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌她根本不是你真的[niece]，只是你从市场上买来的什么该死的精神奴隶之类的。

lines.en: : I'm actually taking care of her because her parents died.
lines.zh: : 我照顾她，其实是因为她父母都去世了。

lines.en: scene yumibridge5
: ...Yeah, well whatever. You’re still a fucking creep.
lines.zh: : ……行吧，随便。你还是个该死的变态。

lines.en: : You say that as if you're a completely respectable and normal person.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得，好像你自己是个完全体面又正常的人似的。

lines.en: scene yumibridge2
: Least I don't spend my time borderline molesting girls on overpasses.
lines.zh: : 至少我不会把时间花在天桥上近乎猥亵女生的身上。

lines.en: : I haven't even touched you.
lines.zh: : 我连碰都没碰过你。

lines.en: : Awesome job. You want a fuckin' medal?
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮。你想要一枚他妈的勋章吗？

lines.en: : I ain't that abnormal, scumbag. I'm just not like the people you're used to bein' around.
lines.zh: : 我没那么不正常，人渣。我只是跟你习惯相处的那类人不一样。

lines.en: : I'll say. You’re more aggressive than basically everyone else I know combined.
lines.zh: : 确实。你比我所认识的所有人加起来还要有攻击性。

lines.en: : So what? Like I said, you don’t know what I’ve been through.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？我说了，你不知道我经历过什么。

lines.en: : Probably on account of you refusing to tell me anything.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你什么都不肯告诉我。

lines.en: scene yumibridge6
: What, are you my dad now?! I don’t have to tell you shit!
lines.zh: : 什么，你现在是我爸吗？！我他妈没必要告诉你任何事！

lines.en: This really isn’t going anywhere...
lines.zh: 这样下去真的毫无进展……

lines.en: scene yumibridge2
: Listen, I’m not here to judge you or...try to discipline you or anything like that. I just thought-
lines.zh: : 听着，我来这儿不是为了评判你，也不是……想管教你之类的。我只是觉得——

lines.en: scene yumibridge5
: Thought what? We could be friends? Fat chance. I’d never willingly spend time with someone like you.
lines.zh: : 觉得什么？觉得我们能当朋友？门都没有。我绝不会心甘情愿地跟你这种人待在一起。

lines.en: : Why, though? What did I ever do to you?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？我到底对你做过什么？

lines.en: scene yumibridge2
: The fuck do you mean {i}What did I ever do to you?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我到底对你做过什么？！{/i}你他妈什么意思？

lines.en: : You think I just up and forgot about all those fucking creepy ass detentions?! Get real!
lines.zh: : 你以为我会一转眼就忘了那些该死的、恶心透顶的留堂处分？！醒醒吧！

lines.en: Detentions?
lines.zh: 留堂？

lines.en: Is she talking about something the old Sensei did?
lines.zh: 她说的是上一任 Sensei 做过的事吗？

lines.en: : Well, what can I do to make it up to you? I want to be on good terms.
lines.zh: : 那么，我该怎么弥补你？我想和你搞好关系。

lines.en: scene yumibridge5
: I’ll need $5,000,000 in cash.
lines.zh: : 我要五百万美元现金。

lines.en: : US Dollars?
lines.zh: : 美元？

lines.en: scene yumibridge2
: There a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 有问题吗？

lines.en: : No, hold on one sec.
lines.zh: : 没有，等一下。

lines.en: scene yumibridge9
: Wait, do you really-
lines.zh: : 等等，你真的——

lines.en: I look through my wallet and pull out some cash.
lines.zh: 我翻了翻钱包，掏出一些现金。

lines.en: : I have 600 yen.
lines.zh: : 我有 600 日元。

lines.en: : I know it's Japanese money, but-
lines.zh: : 我知道这是日元，不过——

lines.en: scene yumibridge6
: That’s not even close! Get the fuck out of here you creep!
lines.zh: : 差得远呢！滚他妈远点，你这变态！

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll just leave this here and-
lines.zh: : 好。我就把这钱放这儿，然后——

lines.en: : I SAID GO BEFORE I KICK YOU IN THE FUCKING BALLS!
lines.zh: : 我说了滚，不然我踢爆你的蛋！

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I’m leaving.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我走。

lines.en: : But if you're not going to take my money-
lines.zh: : 不过你要是不肯收我的钱——

lines.en: scene yumibridge9
: Wait, actually...no. Leave the money. I'm hungry.
lines.zh: : 等等，其实……不。钱留下。我饿了。

lines.en: : I ain't gonna just fuckin' forgive you or think you're cool or whatever, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我可不会就这么他妈原谅你，或者觉得你很酷什么的。

lines.en: : Then what exactly am I getting out of this deal?
lines.zh: : 那这笔交易我到底能得到什么？

lines.en: : The...opportunity to live another day?
lines.zh: : 那个……多活一天的机会？

lines.en: : Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 挺公平的。

lines.en: scene black
Yumi snatches the 600 yen out of my hands and storms away, leaving me alone on the bridge to soak up the remainder of the sunset and contemplate what my life has become.
lines.zh: Yumi 一把从我手里抢过那 600 日元，气冲冲地走了，把我一个人留在桥上，沐浴着最后的夕阳，思考自己的人生到底变成了什么样子。

lines.en: As the day turns to night, I come to the depressing realization that this is very likely not the last time I'll wind up giving her money.
lines.zh: 夜幕降临，我沮丧地意识到：这很可能不是我最后一次给她钱。

lines.en: $ firsttimestreets = True
$ yumi_love += 1
{i}Yumi’s affection has somehow increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度不知怎么提升到了 [yumi_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
